catalysts.headline: Bloomberg reported Edison International/Southern California Edison is considering shutting off power for up to roughly 246,000 customers amid wildfire-risk conditions
catalysts.impact: Operational/PSPS-related disclosure amid ongoing Eaton Fire liability scrutiny

catalysts.headline: Muddy Waters alleged Southern California Edison showed reckless/willful disregard in the Eaton Fire, citing potential liability of at least $4B in fire-related damages and up to roughly $20B if a court found willful misconduct; alleges SCE knew for ~5 years its wildfire risk model could not adequately handle high-wind conditions. Edison said it is cooperating with investigations and denies negligence or wrongdoing.
catalysts.impact: Shares fell more than 3% that session

catalysts.headline: Muddy Waters short report alleging willful disregard in the Eaton Fire, with potential liability cited as high as ~$20B (as carried on file)
catalysts.impact: Not independently verified this session — could not locate a primary or news-wire confirmation before the search budget was exhausted

catalysts.headline: Muddy Waters alleges Edison/SCE acted with 'conscious' or 'willful' disregard in the Eaton Fire; says liability could reach ~$20B if willful misconduct is found (vs ~$4B base case)
Jefferies downgrade to Sell, price target cut to $42

LA County Superior Court Judge Laura Seigle denied Edison International's motion for summary judgment seeking to be dropped from Eaton Fire litigation; the parent company had argued it had no ownership or control over the equipment at issue, but the judge found it had not met its burden of showing it bore no responsibility. The ruling is a denial of summary judgment, not a finding of liability.
catalysts.impact: Keeps Edison International (the parent, not just SCE) as a defendant exposed in Eaton Fire litigation

catalysts.headline: Morgan Stanley reiterates Sell, price target $60
Jefferies cuts price target $68 -> $53, keeps Hold
Truist Securities cuts price target $77 -> $63, keeps Hold
California Assembly declines to vote on SB 492 compromise; bill dies for the session without passing -- the version that stripped liability protections never became law

California State Assembly revised SB 492, stripping out utility wildfire-liability shields and omitting Gov. Newsom's provision barring insurer subrogation suits against utilities; Mizuho cut EIX to Neutral from Outperform, Argus cut to Hold from Buy

Edison International reported Q2 2026 results: core EPS $1.54 (core earnings $592M) vs. $0.97 YoY, beating a ~$1.18 consensus; GAAP EPS $1.39 (net income $534M vs. $343M YoY); reaffirmed FY2026 core EPS guidance of $5.90–$6.20; reported more than 2,200 Eaton Fire compensation offers totaling over $775M, with the company stating it still lacks enough claims/settlement data to set a GAAP low-end liability estimate
catalysts.impact: Core earnings beat; Eaton Fire liability remains unquantified under GAAP pending more claims data

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026: core EPS $1.54 (vs $0.97 Y/Y), GAAP EPS $1.39, revenue $4.357B (missed $4.72B estimate); reaffirmed FY2026 core EPS guidance $5.90-$6.20
